{
  "settings": [
    {
      "name": "enable_profiling",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "PRAGMA enable_profiling = 'json';",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "profiling_output",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "PRAGMA profiling_output = '/path/to/file.json';",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "configure_profiling",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "PRAGMA configure_profiling = '{\"CPU_TIME\": \"false\", \"EXTRA_INFO\": \"true\", \"OPERATOR_CARDINALITY\": \"true\", \"OPERATOR_TIMING\": \"true\"}';",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "profiling_mode",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "PRAGMA profiling_mode = 'detailed';",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    }
  ]
}
